Assignor does hereby assign, transfer and convey to Assignee all of its right, title and interest, as Lessor, in and to a eertain Lease Agreement dated December 13h, 1972 (the "Lease"), originally between Realty Income Trust as lessor (as successor of Pease & Elliman Realty Trust) and Meyer Steinberg, as lessee; a memorandum of which was recorded on December 15, 1972 in the office of the City Register of the County of New York in reel 261 at page 1882 covering all that parcel and the building and improvements thereon as described in Exhibit A attached hereto; said Lease having been assigned by Realty Income Trust to Jean Steinberg as Trustee of the Fee Trusts by Assignment dated October 29, 1981 and recorded on November 6, 1981 in the office of the City Register of the County of Assignor.  2.  Assumption. Assignee hereby accepts and assumes all of the obligations of Assignor under said Lease from and after the date hereof. 3.Merger.
